metadata.title: BaseBlocks - Build the sites you need
metadata.description: Build pages from content, data, and connected tools, then publish them as complete sites.

landing.heroDescription: Pages, files, data, and connected tools are brought together in a site ready to publish.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Content, structure, connections, and access brought into one coherent site.
landing.editorDesc: Combine text, media, data, files, and interaction on the same page.
landing.pageTreeDesc: Arrange pages in a navigable tree with search and relationships across the site.
landing.filesSearchDesc: Place connected material directly on the pages where it belongs.
landing.teamWorkspacesTitle: Sites for every kind of work
landing.teamWorkspacesDesc: Build documentation, team spaces, public resources, storefronts, and what comes next.
landing.publishingDesc: Control access, connect a domain, and publish a finished site.
landing.brandingTitle: A site that feels like yours
landing.brandingDesc: Set its identity, presentation, and domain without rebuilding the underlying pages.
landing.stepsTitle: From blank page to working site
landing.step1Desc: Every page composed from the content, data, and interactions it needs.
landing.step3Desc: Your audience, your domain, and a site ready to share.
